# draftably

> draftably is a text format for diagrams. A `.draft` file lists boxes, groups and connections, one statement per line, and automatic layout draws them. The `draftably` CLI checks, lays out and renders files, and ships an agent skill that teaches coding agents the syntax.

To write a `.draft` file, read the agent skill first. It has the syntax, the layout engines and the check loop. To show or edit diagrams in a web app, start with [Choose how to embed](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed/).

## Docs

- [Agent workflow](https://draftably.dev/docs/agent-skill/): installation, prompts and the check-and-render workflow for agents
- [Agent skill install](https://draftably.dev/docs/agent-skill/): `npx draftably skill install` puts the skill where Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads it
- [Get started](https://draftably.dev/docs/get-started/): a first diagram
- [Diagram recipes](https://draftably.dev/docs/recipes/): complete architecture, handoff, sequence and change-review examples
- [CLI](https://draftably.dev/docs/cli/): `check`, `vary`, `inspect` and the other commands
- [Language reference](https://draftably.dev/docs/rules/): every statement and attribute
- [Layout engines](https://draftably.dev/docs/layout-engines/): placement algorithms and settings
- [Refinements](https://draftably.dev/docs/refinements/): ordering, pins and placement adjustments

## Embed in an app

- [Choose how to embed](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed/): who draws (Draftably, your app, a flow library, or nobody at runtime), with a row per framework
- [Quick start](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed-quick-start/): install the framework package with `@draftably/runtime`, import `host.css` once, the Vite 5–7 `optimizeDeps` setting, one diagram and one event
- [How embedding works](https://draftably.dev/docs/embed-concepts/): `<draft-diagram>` and `<draft-editor>` are the contract; the microtask mount, live options, `status`
- [React and Next.js](https://draftably.dev/docs/react/): a complete Vite app, a Next.js server component and a strict-CSP `proxy.ts`
- [Solid and SolidStart](https://draftably.dev/docs/solid/): a complete Vite app, a SolidStart server query and nonce middleware
- [Vue and Nuxt](https://draftably.dev/docs/vue/): a complete Vite app, Nuxt `useAsyncData` and a nonce Nitro plugin
- [Svelte and SvelteKit](https://draftably.dev/docs/svelte/): a complete Vite app, a SvelteKit `load` and CSP hook
- [Plain HTML and no bundler](https://draftably.dev/docs/plain-html/): the custom elements in any page; serve `dist` from your origin, or use `execution: { mode: 'main' }` from a CDN
- [Editor component](https://draftably.dev/docs/editor-component/): let users drag boxes and lines and get the `.draft` source back
- [Content on nodes](https://draftably.dev/docs/content-on-nodes/): your own markup on a node with `data-draft-slot` and `data-draft-input`
- [Camera and geometry](https://draftably.dev/docs/camera-and-geometry/): `fit`, `reveal`, `getCamera`, `setCamera` and `geometry()`
- [Events and status](https://draftably.dev/docs/events-and-status/): every `draft-<name>` event, which element sends it, its prop name in each framework, and the diagnostic codes
- [Theming](https://draftably.dev/docs/theming/): dark pages, frame colors and editor colors
- [Server rendering and strict CSP](https://draftably.dev/docs/server-rendering/): `renderSvg` fallbacks and a complete nonce policy
- [API reference](https://draftably.dev/docs/api-reference/): every export, element property, viewer option and handle method
- [Performance](https://draftably.dev/docs/performance/): what a page loads, many diagrams, and main-thread mode
- [Troubleshooting](https://draftably.dev/docs/troubleshooting/): each symptom and its fix
- [Upgrade to 0.4](https://draftably.dev/docs/upgrade/): every breaking change, with code before and after

## Graph layout

- [Your app draws](https://draftably.dev/docs/your-app-draws/): when to draw with your own components, and a `layout()` sample that draws boxes, lines, arrowheads and labels
- [Layout API](https://draftably.dev/docs/layout-api/): `layout` and `route` for a graph your app draws
- [Drop in your graph layout](https://draftably.dev/docs/layout-drop-in/): React Flow, Svelte Flow, elkjs, dagre and Cytoscape.js

## Docs and Markdown

- [Switch from Mermaid](https://draftably.dev/docs/from-mermaid/): one package alias
- [Render SVG](https://draftably.dev/docs/render-svg/): the portable runtime in a script or build
- [Markdown](https://draftably.dev/docs/markdown/): remark and markdown-it adapters, includes and generated assets
- [Documentation sites](https://draftably.dev/docs/documentation-sites/): Starlight, Docusaurus and VitePress setup
- [Support](https://draftably.dev/docs/support/): package requirements and tested integrations

## Optional

- [Examples](https://draftably.dev/docs/examples/): diagrams with their source
- [Agent diagram comparison](https://draftably.dev/docs/agent-diagram-evaluation/): how agents do with draftably, Mermaid, D2, Graphviz DOT and raw SVG
